description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Samurai], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Broken Commandment Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Samurai
description.text: Samurai abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Broken Commandment Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Broken Commandment after using three Samurai abilities

description.name: Broken Commandment
description.text: One single attack (5.28) capped at 99999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70%] for 8 seconds
